Lab 1: resource-constrained path planning

Use an expanded state to plan a route under a resource budget and examine computational tradeoffs.

Planned date Nov 3, 2026Proposed outline

Learning objectives

  • Design a state representation that includes a resource budget.
  • Implement and check a DP solution on a small instance.
  • Explain feasibility, optimality and computational cost.
